ideas.title: Following the Money: A Deep Dive into Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the funding delays and mismanagement of funds
questions: What are the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability in the state's Medicaid program. I recommend starting with a review of public records and interviewing sources within the state's health department.
